title: pilot.assign
description: host → server → client (relayed unchanged). The host names who sits in the pilot, co-pilot and booster-pilot seats and where each seat reads its input. The server stores it to authorise pilot.input, pilot.action and copilot.action. Sent at every seat change (each flight segment by default).

segment.description: Segment the assignment is for; null before flight.

pilotId.description: Pilot of the main vehicle; null when nobody is named (host operator flies).

pilotInput.description: Input source of the pilot seat. PHONE requires `pilotId`.

copilotId.description: Co-pilot handling staging and deploys on their phone; null for none.

boosterPilotId.description: Second pilot flying the returning booster; null for none.

boosterInput.description: Input source of the booster seat; null when there is no booster pilot.

FlightSegment.description: Flight segment used for pilot rotation (§9.4).

InputSource.description: Where a pilot seat reads its input from (§9.4 Pass the controls).

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).
